title: Data Type Declaration
prompt:
Declare variables of different data types and assign them values. Print the values and their respective data types.
Sample Input: None
Sample Output: Variable a is of type int and has value 10
Variable b is of type float and has value 3.14
Variable c is of type string and has value hello
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a Python program that declares variables of different data types and assigns them values, then prints the values and their respective data types:

```python
# Declare variables of different data types
a = 10
b = 3.14
c = "hello"

# Print the values and their respective data types
print(f"Variable a is of type int and has value {a}")
print(f"Variable b is of type float and has value {b}")
print(f"Variable c is of type string and has value {c}")
```

When you run this program, it will output:

```
Variable a is of type int and has value 10
Variable b is of type float and has value 3.14
Variable c is of type string and has value hello
```
